title: Getting AI Pilled Without Getting Breached
description:
Your teams want AI connected to everything. How do you enable them without putting your data, credentials, and production systems at risk?

I joined Nipun Gupta of Optimus Labs for a practical conversation about securing enterprise AI adoption—from shadow AI and agent permissions to data retention, endpoint visibility, and healthcare.

We discuss:
• Building guardrails that help employees use AI safely
• Giving agents access to the data they need while limiting their permissions
• Monitoring and controlling individual tool calls
• Addressing shadow AI through education, tooling, and governance
• Understanding zero data retention (ZDR) and provider trust
• Evaluating healthcare use cases, BAA coverage, and third-party integrations
• Starting with the security controls already available in your enterprise tools
